Description
io.webagent4j.recording.replay
 
  • Classes in io.webagent4j.recording.replay used by io.webagent4j.recording.replay
    Class
    Description
    IReplayOutcome
    The result of WorkflowReplayer.replay(io.webagent4j.recording.WorkflowRecordingV2, io.webagent4j.workflow.Workflow): either a successfully replayed decision trace, or a structured, secret-free reason it was rejected before any replay was attempted.
    ReplayedStep
    One entry in a ReplayedWorkflow's flattened, execution-ordered replay sequence: exactly the recorded step, together with the branch decision that led into it if it is a WorkflowStepType.CONDITIONAL step.
    ReplayedWorkflow
    The result of successfully replaying a WorkflowRecordingV2's recorded decision trace against a live workflow: the exact recorded step sequence and branch decisions, confirmed structurally compatible with that workflow's current definition, and nothing else.
    ReplayFailureType
    A structured, secret-free reason Deterministic Replay could not proceed.
    ReplayValidationFailure
    A structured, secret-free reason ReplayValidator.validate(io.webagent4j.recording.WorkflowRecordingV2, io.webagent4j.workflow.Workflow) rejected a WorkflowRecordingV2/Workflow pair for Deterministic Replay.
